DIRECTION_J_DETAILS:
  Pattern locked in lessons.md for future workspace TS packages consumed at Node runtime:
    1. tsconfig.build.json extends tsconfig.json with module/moduleResolution=NodeNext, outDir=./dist, declaration+declarationMap+sourceMap, noEmit:false, composite:false, exclude **/*.test.ts
    2. package.json adds main+types+files=["dist"] + conditional exports of form {"./entry":{"types":"./dist/.../index.d.ts","default":"./dist/.../index.js"}}
    3. Downstream Dockerfile inserts `RUN pnpm --filter @orqafy/<pkg> build` in builder stage BEFORE consuming app's build step
    4. Next.js next.config.ts can DROP the package from transpilePackages once it ships JS
    5. webpack extensionAlias (.js → .ts/.tsx) removable IF other workspace packages don't use .js-style ESM imports in .ts source (verify via grep — zero hits = safe to remove)
    6. Source files using `from "../foo.js"` ESM-style imports emit cleanly under NodeNext — do NOT change source
    7. pnpm-lock.yaml does NOT change when only adding scripts to package.json (lockfile tracks deps not scripts)
  Unblocks: worker boot in staging/prod compose for first Komodo deploy. BullMQ runtime path now functional from packages/jobs/dist/*.js.
